title: FRIDAY Original Speaker V2 — Dataset Manifest
description: P2-M5V9-B.3D.2. Describes one recording session's set of voice assets. Contains NO private contract content and NO real performer PII — speaker_id, rights_record_id, and engineer-style fields are opaque references that resolve elsewhere, in secure, private, non-repository storage (see docs/voice-v2/FRIDAY-V2-PROVENANCE-SPEC.md). NOTE: this schema enforces the SHAPE of each asset entry only. Cross-entry invariants — asset_id uniqueness across the whole manifest, and resolvability of each rights_record_id against a real provenance record — are enforced by the companion validator/QC tool (schemas/voice-v2/validate_examples.py; production tool: friday-voice-dataset-qc, designed in docs/voice-v2/FRIDAY-V2-DATASET-PLAN.md), not by this schema alone.

manifest_id.description: Unique identifier for this manifest file.

speaker_id.description: Opaque reference to the performer. Never a real name — resolves to a real identity only in secure, private, non-repository storage.

session_id.description: Unique identifier for the recording session this manifest documents.

asset_id.description: Unique identifier for this specific asset. Uniqueness ACROSS the manifest's assets array is enforced by the companion validator, not by this per-item schema.

transcript.description: Exact text spoken on this take.

approved.description: Whether this asset has passed QC and rights checks and may be used downstream.

sample_rate.description: Master recording sample rate per FRIDAY-V2-RECORDING-SPEC.md (48kHz target; 44100/96000 tolerated for equipment variance, never lower).

bit_depth.description: 24-bit is the FRIDAY master target; 16 is never acceptable for a new master, only listed for completeness of derived-copy tracking; 32 covers float masters.

channels.description: 1 (mono) is required; 2 is flagged by QC per FRIDAY-V2-RECORDING-SPEC.md, not silently accepted.

peak_dbfs.description: Must be <= 0 dBFS; a clipped file (0 or above in practice) is flagged by QC, not silently accepted.

rights_record_id.description: Opaque reference to the FRIDAY Voice Provenance Record covering this asset's rights basis. An asset with no resolvable rights_record_id must never be used for training/conditioning/cloud upload (docs/voice-v2/FRIDAY-V2-PROVENANCE-SPEC.md).

notes.description: Free text. Must never contain contract text or real PII.
